user.title: Jackery Diagnostics
user.description: This diagnostic tool signs in to the Jackery cloud, probes undocumented endpoints, and creates a Home Assistant notification with the results. Disable the normal Jackery integration and close the official Jackery app first, because Jackery appears to allow only one active account session. Your credentials are used only to authenticate and run the probe.

error.invalid_auth: Could not sign in with those credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Jackery cloud.

abort.already_configured: This Jackery account is already configured.
